metadata.label: Navigate / GPS / BLE / IGC repeat after UART character yielding
metadata.working_tree: Character-yield source committed after this exact binary was built; unchanged installed firmware identified by source manifest and binary hash
metadata.scenario: Physical Leaf on Navigate; 117.461-second recorded interval. Operator described a repeat approximately 90-second run after the previous accidental self-test capture; no self-test reported this time. 225 normal Navigate renders and 1657 complete UART GPS sentences.
metadata.sd_card: Installed Leaf SD card; model and capacity not recorded
metadata.coverage_notes: Captured settings match revision 3: BLE enabled; FANET and optional diagnostic SD logs disabled; thermal features enabled. Connected BLE-client traffic unverified. All 1657 sentences parser-checksum accepted; no omitted/nested/asynchronous/unassigned/partial-ingestion sentences or UART assembly resets. Latest IGC has 130 valid fix records at one-second intervals without gaps. Exact monotonic overlap is not encoded. Navigate is the only measured flight page. Buttons/menu navigation and recovery are separately retained.
metadata.limitations: Short manual bench run with at least 114 normal samples per slot; not automated operational qualification. Prior clean run is 80.691 seconds; durations, GPS phase and GSV counts differ, so formal baseline comparison is withheld. Enabled radios do not establish verified traffic. No independent full-profiler overhead calibration or hardware UART overflow counters. No claim of long-term memory stability or sensor-recovery correctness. A normal slot-78 start/barometer delay of 7.663/7.719 ms is retained only as a maximum; its event predecessor is unavailable and its cause cannot be reconstructed.

igc_evidence.limitations: Latest IGC associated by device session. Exact monotonic capture overlap is not encoded. No position records copied; continuity does not establish every sensor deadline or UART byte reception.

metadata.interpretation: 32/1657 GPS sentences cross deadlines (1.93%), maximum sentence lateness 0.354 ms, versus 75/1057 (7.10%) and 1.825 ms before character yielding. Observational comparison, not a controlled causal estimate. Normal slots still show 156 shallow crossings, maximum 0.386 ms, with zero accumulated-duration overruns and zero coalesced ticks. Heap ends 32 B above start, zero allocation failures, largest free block unchanged. Button recovery has 3 coalesced ticks and delays; slot 78 also has an unexplained normal barometer-call delay and needs follow-up. This capture does not establish wider individual GPS bursts from the phase chart.

baseline_reasons: Measurement durations differ by more than 10%
notes: Normal slot/page statistics exclude held buttons, button events and recovery. Recovery covers the next two dispatched slots and extends while completion is late or start delay exceeds 1 ms; inspect it separately.

GPS summaries include all sentence dispatches, including interactions. Stages are exclusive elapsed times on device (host thread CPU in sim), not isolated CPU costs. UART timestamps observe firmware reads, not wire arrival. Checksum acceptance does not establish a valid position fix.
Recent trace wrapped by design; full-run slot aggregates and the worst incident remain available.
Memory history wrapped; first sample and full-run sampled minima are retained.
Clock-pair, slot-bookkeeping, and memory-sampling costs are reported. Full instrumentation overhead requires an external A/B measurement.
A zero stack reading can mean an unregistered task or no headroom; inspect active task state and raw samples. Positive stack minima skip zero readings.
Stage 1 manual capture: enabled features are not verified workload coverage. Review is required before release.
Baseline comparison withheld: Missing or different scenario; Measurement durations differ by more than 10%.
Memory change is between manual capture endpoints; a negative change alone does not prove a leak. Heap low watermarks include earlier boot activity.
ATTENTION: barometer first-call delay exceeded 1 ms in slots 78. Check conversion timing.
ATTENTION: button recovery includes deadline crossings, coalesced ticks or barometer delays. Button exclusions do not establish safe recovery; check sensor/GPS/IGC continuity on hardware.
